summary_md: **tdual(ティーデュアル)@MatrixFlow ([@tdualdir](https://x.com/tdualdir/status/2116717715574669342))** is excited by *Agent Behavior Maps* by Fujikawa et al. ([arXiv 2610.30014](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.30014)), which places LLM-harness combinations in a geometric space using action log-likelihoods on shared trajectories, without new rollouts, revealing differences that success rates hide.
